summary_en: Nippon Light Metal Holdings will acquire up to 600,000 shares (1.0% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.5 billion through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 4, 2026 to March 31, 2027, as part of capital efficiency improvement and shareholder return enhancement aligned with its 2035 Vision targeting ROIC of 10% or above.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 2, 2026, Nippon Light Metal Holdings' Board of Directors approved a treasury stock acquisition program. The company will purchase up to 600,000 ordinary shares, representing 1.0% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum of ¥1.5 billion. Purchases will be conducted through on-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 4, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The acquisition is positioned as part of the company's capital efficiency improvement and shareholder return enhancement strategy. It aligns with the company's 2035 Vision, which targets ROIC of 10% or above to enable sustained group growth while addressing social challenges. The mid-term business plan for fiscal years 2026-2028 targets ROIC of 8% or above, with an early achievement of stable operating profit exceeding ¥30 billion. The company uses a total return ratio of approximately 40% as a profitability return benchmark, which includes treasury stock acquisitions.

As of September 30, 2026, the company held 62,225 treasury shares out of a total of 61,931,525 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
